title: SettingsSync
description: App settings sync (capability settings-sync). Last-writer-wins: the blob with the greater updated_unix wins; ties go to mac. Send immediately when paired, else on the next heartbeat/announce. notif_mode + muted/allowed_packages (0.9.0+) carry the per-app notification filter; absent means allow-all (all_except_muted with empty lists) for backward compat.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.2.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

notifications_enabled.description: Master switch for phone-to-Mac notification mirroring. Absent means true.

notif_mode.description: Per-app filter mode. all_except_muted=mirror everything except muted_packages (default); only_allowed=mirror only allowed_packages. Absent means all_except_muted. Additive (0.9.0+).

muted_packages.description: Denylist of source packages never mirrored (e.g. com.android.vending for Play progress). Empty/absent means none. Additive (0.9.0+).

allowed_packages.description: Allowlist used only when notif_mode is only_allowed. Empty/absent with only_allowed means nothing mirrors. Additive (0.9.0+).

clipboard_mode.description: Auto clipboard direction. both=bidirectional (default), android_to_mac/phone->Mac only, mac_to_android/Mac->phone only, disabled=off. Absent means both.

updated_unix.description: Unix seconds of the last local change; greater wins.

updated_by.description: Which side made the last change; ties go to mac.
